title: Paper sheet
description: A sheet of paper taped onto the kraft: the screen's title, its lead and the page on it. cover: a large sheet for the module's first screen; stack: a sheet on the left, the backdrop's scene around it; split: the sheet on the left and a second place on the right (a part's number, a list on its own paper).
instructions: Use for the cover, the objectives, part openers, the recap and the end. Keep the title to two lines and the lead to one or two sentences. Pick a light paper (white, mustard, pink, sky, leaf): the text stays in ink on it. split puts the side slot beside the sheet, for a part-number block or a short list.

arrangement.title: Arrangement
arrangement.description: cover: a large sheet, the title set large; stack: one sheet with the title, the lead and the page; split: the sheet on the left, the side slot on the right.

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: The colour of the sheet (a theme token). The text stays in ink: keep to the light papers.

tilt.title: Tilt
tilt.description: How the sheet was laid down: straight, or turned a little to the left or the right.
